title: Inspect and extend: A report chat is a local message list
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/model.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve message append, trimming/search, and conversation display.
problem: A chat screen can feel live while messages remain local. Follow a typed message through the model and UI, and note there is no remote participant or server in this implementation. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/model.ts` and the related project files: src/model.ts; src/screens/ChatScreen.tsx; test/model.test.ts.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to message append, trimming/search, and conversation display.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: No real-time chat, identity system, or server moderation is implemented.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: A chat screen can feel live while messages remain local. Follow a typed message through the model and UI, and note there is no remote participant or server in this implementation.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/model.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
